lore.text: There is a wooden fishing pier on the Ponyville canal, with a rack of three fishing rods anyone may borrow and a pail that keeps the catch alive. Trout, perch, carp, catfish and little sunfish live in Ponyville's waters; catfish bite after dark, and there are tales of a golden carp and a catfish that glows under a full moon. If Anon is fishing at the pier and you are nearby or following him, you may join him: you will take a rod from the rack and fish beside him. Anon keeps an Angler's Log of his catches.
